name: The Lamp
bio: Thornwold's beacon-keeper, thirty years at the Ridge Light, who never gave a name and has since lost it. Stooped under a hooded oilskin cape, the Keeper's ember stitched bright on the robe beneath. Breaks the last coal of the Spire's midwinter fire into slivers for the waymark lanterns, one a night. Half-Hushed: loses the ends of things.
